column1: # Marked free functions whose address sits in a named class's table.
# tools/check_member_owner.py fails on any that is not listed here
# class's slot and a free function says nothing about whose it is. A row says why the body is
# still free: either it cannot become a member
column2: or it has not been moved yet. The second kind

column3: and the row goes when the body moves.

SteppedScrollBitmap::DrawScrolled: the only table holding it is DamageBar's and the two classes are siblings under ScrollBitmap; which of the three owns the body needs the fields decoded, not a rename
EngineObject::CheckObjectAI: folded onto CCircleTrack's and InfoBar's tables; the marker sits on the member the coach interactor calls by name
Object::Trace: folded across 17 unrelated tables, so no one class owns the address
KeyConfigDialog::SaveKeysAs: folded across 5 unrelated tables, so no one class owns the address; the marker sits on the function two callers name

AnimPlayer__GetOrCreateTransform: the plane's slot thirteen calls this address through a variadic declaration with six arguments the callee never pops, and a __thiscall member cannot be spelled that way
CollisionPlane__GetZ: slot body not moved yet; the class forwards to it and the two need collapsing
Stub::Assert: folded across 3 unrelated tables, so no one class owns the address
Screen::OnWidgetMessage: the empty two-argument body folded across unrelated tables and callers; the marker sits on the member whose qualified calls name it
FUN_0042be70: two widget tables hold it, at slots one AND two of each, so no one class can declare it once
KeyConfigDialog::ClearKeys: three tables hold it at slot five, and the dialog calls it by name
Screen_MatchSetup__LoadPreviewFrames: three screen tables hold it at slot four, so no one class can declare it
Screen_ChampionshipSetup__LoadPreviewFrames: one table holds it, but the tree reaches it by name from the preview walk as well; making it a member is a separate change
